title: Setting searchAsYouType as false results to search-as-you-type
body: When using a connector, `connectSearchBox`, with prop `searchAsYouType` as `false`, the search box still behaves same as before, i.e. the queries are still performed as and when it's typed.

comments.body:
Hi @rahuldhawani this is an error on our side, connectors right now embeds the least amount of magic and so there's no searchAsYouType option nor autofocus or shortcuts.

I am removing this from the documentation. You will have to implement this for yourself, by binding a form submit event to the refine method.
